newsitem.title: GERMANY: German police detain owner in shop blast probe.
newsitem.headline: German police detain owner in shop blast probe.

text.p: German police investigating an explosion at a Turkish grocery store which injured 10 people said on Monday they had detained the owner and an accomplice on suspicion of causing the blast.
A police spokesman said the men were suspected of dousing the store with petrol. The accomplice suffered serious burns in the blast in the northern city of Bremen on Saturday night.
Police said they were still not sure of the motive for the blast but they believed it was neither a politically-motivated attack nor an accident.
Three children were among those injured by the explosion, which completely wrecked the supermarket and damaged other buildings and cars nearby.

Around 2.2 million Turks live in Germany. Their property has been the target of several waves of firebomb attacks, sometimes carried out by right-wing extremists but recently more often as the result of rivalries within the Turkish community.
